name: Astrology
belief: Astrology isn't wrong. Her sign shows how she loves, not where she learned to love this way.
words: **Buyers name signs. They don't use chart jargon.** Of 90,321 love and someone chats in the past year, 625 used any astrology word. 367 named a sign ("he is a Scorpian and I am a Gemini", "Interesting that all 3 are born under Gemini") and 162 said "compatible". Chart words barely appear: horoscope 18, birth chart 15, zodiac 15, retrograde 2, Saturn return 0. Signs and "compatible" are this lane's "attract".
The buyers who name signs skew older (quotes mention 56, 61, 62, 68, 70), so plain words beat Instagram jargon.

**"Karmic" stands out.** 167 chats used it, and 20% of them bought, against 8–14% for the other spiritual words in the same pull (soulmate 7.8%, twin flame 10.8%, fate or "meant to be" 9.2%, the universe 13.9%).

**Instagram** astrology-love posts are almost all "zodiac compatibility" and "comment your sign and his". The most-commented one (545k views, 2.2k comments) asks which sign Scorpio "falls in love with over and over again… without even realizing it". That's the pattern belief in astrology clothes.

body.text: Why compatible signs still go wrong
Maybe you've said it yourself. "He's a Scorpio. What did I expect." Or, "Never again with a Gemini."
Then the next one comes along. A different sign. The same ending.
Your friends have heard it all. One sends you his horoscope. One swears a Taurus would settle you down. One says the stars are on your side.
And it's still going the same way. He's warm, then he goes quiet. Or he stays close, and never all the way.
What you've already checked

items: Your horoscope, first thing every morning.
His sign and yours, the night you met.
A compatibility chart that said you were a match.
Your birth chart, down to your Venus sign and Moon sign.
Waiting out Mercury retrograde before you texted him.
Hoping your Saturn return would finally change things.
body.closer: None of it was wrong. It just can't show where this started.

body.text: What your birth chart can't show
Astrology can tell you a lot about how you love. What you need from him. How you show it.
It can't show where you learned to love this way.
Long ago, somebody taught you what to expect from love. Want nothing. Be no trouble. Don't ask him to stay.
That lesson answers first. It picks the same kind of man, whatever his sign.
Evelyn finds where it started, from your first name.
Who Evelyn is
Evelyn Cross is a seer in the west of Ireland. Her teacher could do this. So could her teacher's teacher.
She works at night, by candlelight. One first name at a time. She doesn't need a photo, or his name.
She knows astrology the way you do. She looks past the man, and his sign, to where it started.
When you send your first name
You send your first name. That's all.
Evelyn writes back. Her first message is short. Then she'll ask you one question.
Messaging Evelyn is free.
If she sees where it started, she'll offer to write it down. A letter, written at night, by candlelight. That part isn't free. She'll tell you so plainly before anything happens.
It starts the same way for every woman. One first name.
